content:
# Salesforce CRM – Collections Management System

> **Important Notice**: This repository is a **reconstructed Salesforce DX reference implementation** based on the *Salesforce CRM – Collections Management* project presentation for **Srinidhi Associates**. These files are freshly authored reference code and metadata—not previously deployed production source code. Features requiring manual Salesforce org configuration (such as Slack Named Credential endpoints, Einstein Prompt Builder activation, Flow activation, and Management Dashboards) are explicitly documented.

## 1. Business Problem

**Srinidhi Associates** is a loan recovery agency managing Non-Performing Asset (NPA) accounts for Banks and NBFCs across multiple branches and states. Prior to Salesforce adoption, operations relied on fragmented Excel spreadsheets, creating key bottlenecks:

- Manual case allocation across telecallers and field executives.
- No centralized customer, loan, and follow-up visibility.
- Delayed managerial reporting and no real-time escalation alerts.
- Limited field accountability for non-contactable borrowers.
- Baseline operational metrics: **20% Recovery Rate**, **40% Contactability**, **35% Follow-up Compliance**.

## 2. Proposed Solution

A unified **Salesforce CRM – Collections Management System** built on Salesforce Platform that centralizes customer and loan data, automates telecaller assignment and loan closure, provides a single-screen Lightning Web Component (`customerLoanDetails`), pushes real-time Slack alerts, and integrates AI-assisted risk analysis.

Target outcomes from the project presentation:
- Recovery Rate: `20% → 50%`
- Contactability: `40% → 90%`
- Follow-Up Compliance: `35% → 95%`
- ~70% reduction in manual monitoring effort.

## 3. Key Features

| Module | Implementation Status | Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Custom Data Model (5 Objects)** | Implemented (Metadata XML) | `Customer__c`, `Loan_Account__c`, `Collection_Case__c`, `Payment__c`, `Field_Visit__c` with relationships, formulas, and validation rules |
| **Apex Service Layer & Triggers** | Implemented (Apex + Tests) | `LoanManagementController`, `LoanManagementService`, `TelecallerAssignmentService`, `RiskAnalysisService`, `SlackNotificationService`, `LoanClosureService` |
| **Single-Screen Telecaller LWC** | Implemented (LWC Bundle) | `customerLoanDetails` — Customer, Loan, Collection Case, and Risk Indicator on one screen |
| **Flow Automation (5 Flows)** | Implemented (Draft XML) | Case Escalation, 6 PM Daily Summary, Payment Processing, Loan Auto Closure, Field Visit Tracking (require activation in org) |
| **Slack Integration** | Implemented (Apex + Named Credential template) | Channels: `#collection-manager-alerts`, `#daily-collection-summary`, `#field-executive-updates` (requires live Slack webhook in Named Credential) |
| **Einstein AI Risk Analysis** | Hybrid (Rule-Based Fallback + Prompt Builder Design) | Deterministic fallback works out of the box; Einstein Prompt Builder requires Einstein Generative AI license & manual setup |
| **Role-Based Security** | Implemented (Permission Sets) | `Collections_Manager_Access`, `Telecaller_Access`, `Field_Executive_Access` |

## 4. Technology Stack

- **Backend**: Salesforce Apex (API v61.0), SOQL, Triggers, Invocable Actions, Queueable Callouts
- **Frontend**: Lightning Web Components (LWC), HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SLDS
- **Automation**: Salesforce Record-Triggered Flows & Scheduled Flows
- **Integration**: Slack Incoming Webhooks / REST API via Salesforce Named Credentials
- **AI**: Salesforce Einstein Prompt Builder design + Deterministic Apex Rule-Based Fallback
- **Tooling**: Salesforce DX (`sf` CLI), Metadata API v61.0

## 5. System Architecture

```text
[Telecallers / Field Executives / Managers]
                    │
        ┌───────────┴───────────┐
        ▼                       ▼
[customerLoanDetails LWC]   [Salesforce Mobile App]
        │                       │ (Field Visits + GPS + Files)
        ▼                       ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                Salesforce Platform                │
│  Apex Controllers & Bulk-Safe Service Layer       │
│  ├── LoanManagementController                     │
│  ├── LoanManagementService + LoanClosureService   │
│  ├── TelecallerAssignmentService                  │
│  ├── RiskAnalysisService (Fallback + Einstein)    │
│  └── SlackNotificationService (Queueable)         │
│                                                   │
│  Declarative Automation (5 Flows)                 │
│  Data Model: Customer -> Loan -> Case/Payment/FV  │
└───────────────┬───────────────────┬───────────────┘
                │                   │
                ▼                   ▼
     [Named Credential]    [Einstein Prompt Builder]
                │           (Manual Org Setup Req.)
                ▼
      [Slack Workspace]
      ├── #collection-manager-alerts
      ├── #daily-collection-summary
      └── #field-executive-updates
```

## 6. Project Folder Structure

```text
salesforce-collections-management/
├── README.md
├── FILE_MANIFEST.md
├── .gitignore
├── sfdx-project.json
├── force-app/main/default/
│   ├── classes/          (7 Apex classes + 6 Test classes + 1 Callout Mock)
│   ├── triggers/         (PaymentTrigger, CollectionCaseTrigger)
│   ├── lwc/              (customerLoanDetails)
│   ├── objects/          (5 Custom Objects with fields & validation rules)
│   ├── flows/            (5 Flow metadata XML files)
│   ├── layouts/          (Customer__c page layout)
│   ├── permissionsets/   (Manager, Telecaller, Field Executive)
│   ├── tabs/             (5 Custom Object tabs)
│   ├── labels/           (Slack channel Custom Labels)
│   └── namedCredentials/ (Slack_Collections_Webhook template)
├── docs/                 (8 detailed technical architecture guides)
├── scripts/              (Anonymous Apex seed script & SOQL audit query)
└── screenshots/          (Portfolio screenshot guide)
```

## 7. Quick Start: Installation & Deployment

### Prerequisites
- [Salesforce CLI (`sf`)](https://developer.salesforce.com/tools/salesforcecli) v2+
- A Salesforce Developer Edition org, Sandbox, or Dev Hub Scratch Org

### Deploy to Target Org
```bash
# 1. Authenticate with your target org
sf org login web --alias collections-dev

# 2. Deploy all metadata
sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app --target-org collections-dev

# 3. Assign Permission Sets
sf org assign permset --name Collections_Manager_Access --target-org collections-dev

# 4. Run all Apex unit tests
sf apex run test --test-level RunLocalTests --result-format human --code-coverage --target-org collections-dev

# 5. (Optional) Seed sample Srinidhi Associates data
sf apex run --file scripts/apex/seedSampleData.apex --target-org collections-dev
```

## 8. Post-Deployment Manual Configuration

1. **Slack Named Credential**: Update `Slack_Collections_Webhook` in Setup → Named Credentials with your real Slack Incoming Webhook URL.
2. **Activate Flows**: Open Flow Builder and activate the 5 deployed Flows after verifying the Slack Named Credential.
3. **Add LWC to Record Page**: Edit the `Customer__c` Lightning Record Page in Lightning App Builder and drag `Customer Loan & Collection Details` onto the main region.
4. **Einstein Prompt Builder**: Follow [`docs/einstein-ai-configuration.md`](docs/einstein-ai-configuration.md) to configure the `Collections_Loan_Risk_Analysis` Flex Prompt Template in Einstein-licensed orgs.
5. **Reports & Dashboards**: Build the Loan Dashboard, Call Records, and Payment Dashboards in Reports & Dashboards using the deployed custom objects.

## 9. Documentation Index

- [System Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Data Model & Relationships](docs/data-model.md)
- [Apex Implementation](docs/apex-implementation.md)
- [LWC Implementation](docs/lwc-implementation.md)
- [Flow Automation](docs/automation.md)
- [Slack Integration](docs/slack-integration.md)
- [Einstein AI Configuration](docs/einstein-ai-configuration.md)
- [Deployment & GitHub Guide](docs/deployment-guide.md)
- [Complete File Manifest](FILE_MANIFEST.md)

## 10. Future Enhancements (Roadmap from Presentation)

- **Collect Payment Quick Action** directly inside the `customerLoanDetails` LWC.
- **Settlement Creation Workflow** with automatic waiver calculation and Bank approval routing.
- **CTI / Dialer Integration** with auto-logged call duration and recordings.
- **Promise-to-Pay (PTP) Tracking** with automated customer reminders and escalation on broken promises.
- **WhatsApp / SMS Notifications** and an **External Bank Monitoring Portal** (Experience Cloud).

name: apex-implementation.md
content:
# Apex Implementation Guide

All Apex classes follow Salesforce Enterprise Patterns: `with sharing`, bulk-safe collections (zero SOQL/DML inside loops), CRUD/FLS checks (`Schema.sObjectType`, `WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED`, `Security.stripInaccessible`), and explicit exception handling.

## Class Inventory

1. **`LoanManagementController`**
   - `@AuraEnabled(cacheable=true) getCustomerLoanDashboard(Id customerId)`: Single round-trip DTO returning `CustomerSummary`, `List<LoanSummary>`, `List<CollectionCaseSummary>`, and `RiskAnalysisService.RiskAssessmentResult`.
   - `@AuraEnabled refreshLoanRiskAnalysis(Id loanAccountId)`: Re-evaluates and persists `Risk_Level__c` on demand.

2. **`LoanManagementService`**
   - `processSuccessfulPayments(List<Payment__c> payments)`: Aggregates successful payments per loan using a `Map<Id, Decimal>`, locks parent `Loan_Account__c` records with `FOR UPDATE`, validates against overpayments, updates `Amount_Paid__c` and `Outstanding_Amount__c`, and delegates zero-balance loans to `LoanClosureService`.
   - `recalculateLoanBalances(Set<Id> loanIds)`: Reconciles exact totals using `AggregateResult` (`SUM(Payment_Amount__c)`).

3. **`TelecallerAssignmentService`**
   - `assignTelecallers(List<Collection_Case__c> cases)`: Supports configurable `LEAST_LOADED` (default) and `ROUND_ROBIN` strategies.
   - Queries active users with the `Telecaller_Access` permission set (`Assignee.IsActive = true`), preventing assignment to inactive users.

4. **`RiskAnalysisService`**
   - `analyzeLoanRisk(Loan_Account__c, Customer__c, Collection_Case__c)`: Deterministic rule-based fallback scoring overdue days, collection efficiency, non-contactability, and escalation status to produce `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, or `HIGH` risk with all 7 required outputs.
   - `evaluateAndPersistRisk(Id loanAccountId)`: Updates `Loan_Account__c.Risk_Level__c` with FLS enforcement.
   - `buildEinsteinPromptInputMap(Id loanAccountId)`: Constructs the input map for Einstein Prompt Builder Flex Template `Collections_Loan_Risk_Analysis`.

5. **`SlackNotificationService`**
   - `@InvocableMethod sendNotificationsFromFlow(List<SlackNotificationRequest>)`: Enqueues `SlackDispatchQueueable` (`Database.AllowsCallouts`) to avoid uncommitted-work callout errors after DML.
   - Uses `callout:Slack_Collections_Webhook` Named Credential.

6. **`LoanClosureService`**
   - `@InvocableMethod closeEligibleLoansInvocable(List<Id> loanIds)` and `closeEligibleLoans(Set<Id> loanAccountIds)`: Verifies `Outstanding_Amount__c <= 0`, sets `Loan_Status__c = 'Closed'` and `Risk_Level__c = 'LOW'`, and closes open associated `Collection_Case__c` records with `Collection_Status__c = 'Recovered'`.

7. **`DailyCollectionSummaryInvocable`**
   - `@InvocableMethod executeDailySummary()`: Aggregates `Collection_Case__c` counts by `Case_Status__c` and dispatches the daily summary to `#daily-collection-summary`.

## Triggers

- **`PaymentTrigger`** (`after insert, after update`): Filters records newly entering `Payment_Status__c = 'Success'` and delegates to `LoanManagementService.processSuccessfulPayments()`.
- **`CollectionCaseTrigger`** (`before insert`): Delegates to `TelecallerAssignmentService.assignTelecallers()` so assignments occur in-memory without extra DML.

name: architecture.md
content:
# System Architecture

## 1. Architectural Overview

The **Salesforce CRM – Collections Management System** uses a layered Salesforce Enterprise Architecture pattern designed for multi-branch NPA loan recovery operations at **Srinidhi Associates**:

1. **Presentation Layer (LWC + Mobile)**:
   - `customerLoanDetails` LWC embedded on the `Customer__c` Lightning Record Page gives telecallers a unified 360-degree view (Customer, Loans, Collection Cases, Risk Indicator) with zero tab switching.
   - Salesforce Mobile App enables Field Executives to capture GPS coordinates and attach geo-tagged visit photographs via standard Salesforce Files (`ContentDocumentLink`).

2. **Service & Domain Layer (Apex)**:
   - Thin triggers (`PaymentTrigger`, `CollectionCaseTrigger`) delegate strictly to bulk-safe Apex service classes.
   - `LoanManagementService` and `LoanClosureService` maintain transactional integrity across `Payment__c`, `Loan_Account__c`, and `Collection_Case__c`.
   - `TelecallerAssignmentService` enforces workload balancing (`LEAST_LOADED` or `ROUND_ROBIN`) across active users only.
   - `RiskAnalysisService` cleanly separates deterministic rule-based scoring from optional Salesforce Einstein Prompt Builder invocation.

3. **Automation Layer (Salesforce Flows)**:
   - Record-Triggered Flows handle real-time Slack alerts for Case Escalations and Field Visits, plus automated loan closure checks.
   - A Scheduled Flow executes daily at 6:00 PM to aggregate portfolio counts via `DailyCollectionSummaryInvocable` and post to `#daily-collection-summary`.

4. **Integration & Security Layer**:
   - All outbound Slack HTTP callouts authenticate through a Salesforce **Named Credential** (`callout:Slack_Collections_Webhook`) inside a `Queueable` job implementing `Database.AllowsCallouts`.
   - Sharing is enforced via `with sharing`, `WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED`, `Schema.sObjectType` CRUD checks, and `Security.stripInaccessible`.

## 2. Licensing & Role Hierarchy Alignment

Based on the Srinidhi Associates licensing model (19 total users):
- **CEO (1 - Salesforce License)**: Full reports and executive dashboards.
- **VP (1 - Salesforce License)**: Read/Edit oversight across all custom objects.
- **Managers / Admin (2 - Salesforce License)**: `Collections_Manager_Access` permission set for case monitoring, escalations, and user control.
- **Telecallers (5 - Salesforce Platform License)**: `Telecaller_Access` permission set for customer calling and case updates.
- **Field Executives (10 - Salesforce Platform License)**: `Field_Executive_Access` permission set for field visits, GPS uploads, and payment logging.

> Note: Salesforce Platform licenses support full Apex, LWC, Flows, and API integrations, but do not include Service Cloud Omni-Channel or full CTI. Upgrading to Service Cloud is recommended for future large-scale call center expansion.

# Salesforce Flow Automation Guide

All 5 business automation workflows are provided as Salesforce Flow Metadata XML files in `force-app/main/default/flows/` with `<status>Draft</status>` so administrators can review and activate them safely after configuring the Slack Named Credential.

## Flow Inventory

| Flow API Name | Type | Trigger Object & Criteria | Apex Action Invoked |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Case_Escalation_Slack_Alert` | Record-Triggered (After Save) | `Collection_Case__c` when `Case_Status__c` becomes `Escalated` | `SlackNotificationService` (`#collection-manager-alerts`) |
| `Daily_Collection_Summary_Slack` | Scheduled (Daily 18:00) | Runs daily at 6:00 PM | `DailyCollectionSummaryInvocable` (`#daily-collection-summary`) |
| `Payment_Processing_Auto_Update` | Record-Triggered (After Save) | `Payment__c` when `Payment_Status__c` becomes `Success` | `LoanClosureService` (after `PaymentTrigger` updates balances) |
| `Loan_Auto_Closure` | Record-Triggered (After Save) | `Loan_Account__c` when `Outstanding_Amount__c <= 0` and `Loan_Status__c != Closed` | `LoanClosureService` |
| `Field_Visit_Tracking_Notification` | Record-Triggered (After Save) | `Field_Visit__c` on Create & Update | `SlackNotificationService` (`#field-executive-updates`) |

## Manual Flow Builder Configuration & Activation Steps

1. Go to **Setup → Process Automation → Flows**.
2. Open each of the 5 deployed Flows (`Draft` status):
   - Verify the **Start** trigger criteria and schedule timezone (`Daily_Collection_Summary_Slack` is set to `18:00:00.000Z`; adjust for IST `18:00` in your org's Default Workflow User timezone).
   - Confirm the Apex Action input variables map cleanly to `$Record` fields.
3. Click **Debug** with a sample record to verify execution without errors.
4. Click **Activate** on each Flow.

### Field Visit Photo Attachment Support
- Standard Salesforce **Files** related list is enabled on `Field_Visit__c`.
- Field Executives using the Salesforce Mobile App can upload geo-tagged site photos directly to the `Field_Visit__c` record; Salesforce stores them as `ContentVersion` linked via `ContentDocumentLink`.

# Data Model & Relationships

## Entity Relationship Overview

```text
Customer__c (Master)
  ├──< Loan_Account__c (Master-Detail: Customer__c)
  │      ├──< Payment__c (Master-Detail: Loan_Account__c, Lookup: Customer__c)
  │      ├──< Collection_Case__c (Lookup: Loan_Account__c, Lookup: Customer__c)
  │      └──< Field_Visit__c (Lookup: Loan_Account__c, Lookup: Customer__c)
  │
  User (Standard)
  ├──< Collection_Case__c (Lookup: Assigned_Telecaller__c, Assigned_Field_Executive__c)
  └──< Field_Visit__c (Lookup: Assigned_Executive__c)
```

## 1. Customer__c (`Customer`)
- **Name Field**: `Name` (Text — Customer Name)
- **Sharing Model**: `ReadWrite`
- **Fields**:
  - `Phone_Number__c` (Phone, Required, Track History)
  - `Email__c` (Email)
  - `Address__c` (LongTextArea 1000)
  - `State__c` (Picklist: Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Delhi, Gujarat, Other)
  - `Branch__c` (Text 100)
  - `Contactability_Status__c` (Picklist: Contactable, Non-Contactable, Switched Off, Wrong Number, Pending Verification)
- **Validation Rule**: `Require_Valid_Phone_Length` — requires at least 10 characters.

## 2. Loan_Account__c (`Loan Account`)
- **Name Field**: `Name` (AutoNumber: `LN-{0000}`, Label: Loan Number)
- **Sharing Model**: `ControlledByParent` (Master-Detail to `Customer__c`)
- **Fields**:
  - `Customer__c` (Master-Detail → `Customer__c`)
  - `Loan_Amount__c` (Currency 16,2, Required)
  - `Outstanding_Amount__c` (Currency 16,2, Required, Track History)
  - `Amount_Paid__c` (Currency 16,2, Default 0, Track History)
  - `Interest_Rate__c` (Percent 5,2)
  - `Due_Date__c` (Date, Required)
  - `Loan_Status__c` (Picklist: Active, Overdue, NPA, Settled, Closed)
  - `Risk_Level__c` (Picklist: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH)
  - `Collection_Efficiency__c` (Formula Percent: `IF(Loan_Amount__c > 0, Amount_Paid__c / Loan_Amount__c, 0)`)
  - `Days_Overdue__c` (Formula Number: days past `Due_Date__c` when not Closed)
- **Validation Rule**: `Non_Negative_Balances` — prevents zero/negative loan amounts or negative balances.

## 3. Collection_Case__c (`Collection Case`)
- **Name Field**: `Name` (AutoNumber: `CC-{00000}`, Label: Case Number)
- **Sharing Model**: `Private`
- **Fields**:
  - `Customer__c` (Lookup → `Customer__c`, Required)
  - `Loan_Account__c` (Lookup → `Loan_Account__c`, Required)
  - `Assigned_Telecaller__c` (Lookup → `User`)
  - `Assigned_Field_Executive__c` (Lookup → `User`)
  - `Case_Status__c` (Picklist: New, In Progress, Follow-Up Scheduled, Field Visit Requested, Escalated, Closed)
  - `Priority__c` (Picklist: Low, Medium, High, Critical)
  - `Escalation_Reason__c` (LongTextArea 1000)
  - `Next_Follow_Up_Date__c` (Date)
  - `Collection_Status__c` (Picklist: Pending, Partial Payment, Promise to Pay, Non-Contactable, Recovered, Settled)
- **Validation Rule**: `Require_Escalation_Reason` — `Escalation_Reason__c` is mandatory when `Case_Status__c = 'Escalated'`.

## 4. Payment__c (`Payment`)
- **Name Field**: `Name` (AutoNumber: `PAY-{00000}`, Label: Payment Reference)

## 5. Field_Visit__c (`Field Visit`)
- **Name Field**: `Name` (AutoNumber: `FV-{00000}`, Label: Visit Reference)

# Einstein AI & Risk Analysis Configuration

## Architectural Transparency: Rule-Based Fallback vs. Einstein Prompt Builder

This repository strictly separates deterministic Apex logic from Salesforce Einstein Generative AI:

1. **Rule-Based Fallback Risk Engine (`RiskAnalysisService.calculateRuleBasedRisk`)**:
   - Implemented in pure Apex and works immediately in Developer Edition orgs and Scratch Orgs without paid AI add-ons.
   - Scores overdue days, collection efficiency %, non-contactability, and case escalation to produce `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, or `HIGH` risk and all 7 required analytical outputs.
   - Explicitly tags `analysisSource = 'Rule-Based Fallback'` in the UI and DTO.
2. **Salesforce Einstein Prompt Builder Integration**:
   - Requires a Salesforce org licensed for **Einstein 1 / Einstein Generative AI** with **Prompt Builder** enabled.
   - `RiskAnalysisService.buildEinsteinPromptInputMap(loanAccountId)` prepares the exact `Input:Loan_Account` parameter map expected by `ConnectApi.EinsteinLLM.generateMessagesForPromptTemplate('Collections_Loan_Risk_Analysis', ...)`.

## Required Output Structure (7 Fields)

1. **Loan Metrics Summary**
2. **Collection Efficiency %**
3. **Risk Level Indicator** (`LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`)
4. **3-Line Professional Assessment**
5. **Recommended Telecaller Action**
6. **Suggested Communication Tone**
7. **Field Visit Required** (`YES` / `NO`)

## Manual Salesforce Setup to Activate Einstein Prompt Builder

1. **Enable Einstein Generative AI**:
   - Go to **Setup → Einstein Setup** and toggle **Turn on Einstein** to **On**.
2. **Assign Required Permissions**:
   - Assign **Prompt Template Manager** (to Admins/Architects) and **Prompt Template User** (to Telecallers and Managers).
3. **Create the Flex Prompt Template**:
   - Go to **Setup → Einstein Studio → Prompt Builder → New Prompt Template**.
   - **Template Type**: `Flex`
   - **Template Name**: `Collections Loan Risk Analysis`
   - **API Name**: `Collections_Loan_Risk_Analysis`
   - **Sources**: Add `Loan_Account__c` (API Input Name: `Loan_Account`).
4. **Prompt Template Instructions**:
   ```text
   You are a senior NPA loan recovery analyst for Srinidhi Associates.
   Analyze Loan Account {!$Input:Loan_Account.Name}:
   - Loan Amount: {!$Input:Loan_Account.Loan_Amount__c}
   - Amount Paid: {!$Input:Loan_Account.Amount_Paid__c}
   - Outstanding Amount: {!$Input:Loan_Account.Outstanding_Amount__c}
   - Days Overdue: {!$Input:Loan_Account.Days_Overdue__c}
   - Loan Status: {!$Input:Loan_Account.Loan_Status__c}
   - Customer Contactability: {!$Input:Loan_Account.Customer__r.Contactability_Status__c}

   Return structured JSON containing:
   loanMetricsSummary, collectionEfficiencyPercent, riskLevel (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH),
   threeLineAssessment, recommendedTelecallerAction, suggestedCommunicationTone,
   and fieldVisitRequired (YES|NO).
   ```
5. **Save & Activate** the Prompt Template, then invoke it from `RiskAnalysisService` using `ConnectApi.EinsteinLLM.generateMessagesForPromptTemplate()`.

# Lightning Web Component Implementation (`customerLoanDetails`)

## Business Objective

Before `customerLoanDetails`, telecallers had to open three separate tabs (Customer → Loan Account → Collection Case) before placing a single recovery call. This LWC consolidates all four operational sections directly onto the `Customer__c` Lightning Record Page:

1. **Section 1 — Customer Details**: Name, Phone Number (`lightning-formatted-phone`), Email (`lightning-formatted-email`), Branch/State, Address, and Contactability Status.
2. **Section 2 — Loan Details**: Loan Number, Total Loan Amount (INR), Outstanding Amount (emphasized), Amount Paid, and Loan Status for each linked `Loan_Account__c`.
3. **Section 3 — Collection Case**: Case Number, Case Status, Priority, Assigned Telecaller, and Next Follow-Up Date for each linked `Collection_Case__c`.
4. **Section 4 — Risk Indicator & Recovery Guidance**: Risk Classification (`LOW` / `MEDIUM` / `HIGH`), Collection Efficiency %, Field Visit Required (`YES`/`NO`), Suggested Communication Tone, 3-Line Professional Assessment, and Recommended Telecaller Action, along with transparent attribution of the analysis source (`Rule-Based Fallback` vs. `Einstein Prompt Builder`).

content:
# Slack Integration Architecture & Setup

## Overview

Salesforce acts as the system of record for loans, telecaller updates, and field visits. Slack acts as the real-time managerial notification layer across three dedicated channels:

1. **`#collection-manager-alerts`** — Real-time alerts when a `Collection_Case__c` is marked `Escalated` (includes Customer, Loan, Assigned Executive, and Escalation Reason).
2. **`#daily-collection-summary`** — Daily 6:00 PM performance digest showing Total, Closed, Pending, and Escalated cases.
3. **`#field-executive-updates`** — Real-time updates when a Field Executive records a `Field_Visit__c` with GPS Latitude/Longitude coordinates.

## Security Model (Zero Hardcoded Secrets)

`SlackNotificationService.cls` **never** stores webhook URLs, OAuth tokens, or signing secrets in Apex code or metadata. All HTTP POST requests target:

```apex
callout:Slack_Collections_Webhook
```

A placeholder template is included at `force-app/main/default/namedCredentials/Slack_Collections_Webhook.namedCredential-meta.xml`.

## Manual Org Configuration Steps

### Step 1: Create a Slack App & Webhook / Bot Token
1. Open [api.slack.com/apps](https://api.slack.com/apps) and create a Slack App for your workspace.
2. Either enable **Incoming Webhooks** (for single-channel routing) OR configure a **Bot Token** (`chat:write` scope) targeting `https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage` so the `channel` JSON field routes dynamically to `#collection-manager-alerts`, `#daily-collection-summary`, and `#field-executive-updates`.
3. Invite the Slack App bot to all three channels.

### Step 2: Configure Salesforce Named Credential
1. Navigate to **Setup → Security → Named Credentials**.
2. Open **Slack Collections Webhook** (`Slack_Collections_Webhook`).
3. Update the **URL** to your real Slack Incoming Webhook URL or `https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage`.
4. If using `chat.postMessage`, configure an **External Credential** with a custom `Authorization: Bearer <BotToken>` header using Named Principals.
5. Grant External Credential Principal Access to `Collections_Manager_Access`, `Telecaller_Access`, and `Field_Executive_Access` permission sets.

## Testing & Mocking

Unit tests use `SlackHttpCalloutMock.cls` (`HttpCalloutMock`) to verify both HTTP 200 success payloads and HTTP 500 error handling without making real outbound calls.
